results.detail: The single SQL statement runs two UPDATEs: Gen_fundmainBase and Gen_customeraccountBase set Gen_depositmfpercentage = 0 where = 9.9, on connection [CRM] (PSQL/ALTSHULER_MSCRM). Scope note verified: one ExecuteSQLTask, no data flows, <DTS:Variables/>, no DTS:Configurations element, no event handlers or log providers. 0014 [CRM] also points at ALTSHULER_MSCRM and reads gen_accountcourses. The meaning of 9.9 is correctly labelled a hypothesis.
There is one executable and no DTS:PrecedenceConstraints element.
Direct DML on the base tables through an OLE DB connection to the CRM catalog. The platform side effects are worded as general platform behaviour.
DTS:Description='backup all tabales that will be changed in end of year process'; Application Name=SSIS-EndOfYearBackup-...; the content is two UPDATEs. The origin is labelled a hypothesis.

No TransactionOption and no transaction on the task or package, no log providers, no event handlers, no ETL record. The partial-commit consequence is worded conditionally.
Both UPDATE statements and the exact 9.9 -> 0 replacement verified.
Direct DB access, the exact equality condition and the write to 0 on both tables verified. The end state applies to the two base tables and the meaning is labelled a hypothesis.

Verified: connection string (Integrated Security=SSPI), no other filter, the two conditions and SET clauses, both statements in one SqlStatementSource, no transaction, no ModifiedOn/ModifiedBy set. The platform behaviour is labelled general.
Verified. 9.99 is not matched by '= 9.9'. Unsupported classification is correct (direct DML on the CRM catalog).
Two direct SQL UPDATEs on Gen_fundmainBase / Gen_customeraccountBase. The package has no constraints or conditions, so they run on every run.

[2] is a policy question and stays open. [3] holds: no supplied package references FundSetMF and none uses an Execute Package task. [1] is only partly open: the supplied files show who writes gen_depositmfpercentage.

wrongUnits.problem: Asks 'who writes it?' as if unknown, but the writers of the attribute are in the supplied packages.
wrongUnits.correct: gen_depositmfpercentage is written to gen_fundmain by 0008_LeumiFile-PY and 0009_LeumiFile-BY (SDK scripts, e.g. 0008:23804, 0009:27047), and to gen_customeraccount by 0005_Customer Account (e.g. 0005:18360, 42817). 0004_LeumiFile-MY maps 9.99 -> 0 in its pipeline (0004:59853). Whether any of them actually delivers the value 9.9 depends on input-file data, and the business meaning of 9.9 remains unknown.
